10 Detection Algorithms. One Connected Investigation.
Shared infrastructure
G06 Shared Device: device matching and grouping
G07 Shared IP: IP address grouping, score capped
Beneficiary relationships
G05 Shared Beneficiary: common beneficiary matching
B02 Concentration: 70%+ of outflow to one beneficiary, min $5,000
Transaction behaviour
T06 Rapid Fund Movement: out within 2 hours, turnover 80%+
T08 Circular: nx.simple_cycles(), loops of 3 to 7
Account flow patterns
A07 Funnel: in-degree, 3+ distinct source accounts
A09 Dispersal: out-degree, 3+ distinct destinations
Identity and access anomalies
K03 Reused Contact: Pandas groupby on phone, email, tax ID
D04 New Device: set comparison with device history
Scores are predefined per detector, not ML probabilities. Circular 96, Rapid 84-94, Funnel and Dispersal 68-86. Shared Device 32-48 and Shared IP 28-42 are capped because shared networks and devices are often legitimate.
T08 finds the closed loop and emits a finding: accounts, transaction IDs, risk 96.
AI reasoning pipeline
Pattern → Hypothesis → Evidence → Alternative → Risk → Recommended review
Gemini writes the narrative from structured findings. It does not declare guilt.
Alternative explanation
A circular pattern can also be legitimate corporate treasury cash pooling or intercompany debt netting.

Screenshots: running prototype. Example below: illustrative, not a measured result
Three accounts form a circular network. The graph engine detects the closed path and records the accounts, transaction IDs, risk score and evidence. Gemini turns the finding into a narrative and suggests what to examine next.

Explainable Intelligence. Human-Controlled Decisions.
Dynamic adaptation: the surprise scenario
Initial
Three accounts share one IP; G07 flags a low-to-medium risk finding.
New evidence
Investigator finds all three used a shared institutional network.
Adapted
Shared IP treated as possibly legitimate. Check devices, beneficiaries, flows.
Result
No single signal decides. The investigator weighs the wider network.
Responsible AI
  • Explainable, rule-based detectors
  • Traceable transaction and entity evidence
  • Alternative legitimate hypotheses
  • Shared IP and device risk caps
  • Gemini key in environment config
  • Template fallback if Gemini is down
  • Human makes the final decision
  • No autonomous legal or punitive action
Evaluation dimensions: to be measured, no figures claimed
Network discovery
Links related entities
Traceability
Entities and transaction IDs cited
False positives
Conservative IP and device scores
Explainability
Detector reasons, alternatives
Efficiency
Fewer manual link searches
NEXUS AI doesn't just flag suspicious transactions. It reveals the network, explains the evidence and empowers investigators to make informed decisions.
